## Jurisdiction and reusable purpose

Describe the official portal, service or template being added or corrected.

## Verification

State official ownership evidence, check date/method, limitations, and any
APN-format or tax-year behavior. Use only reusable official entry-point URLs.
Do not include sample APNs, individual bill URLs, specific meeting documents,
private information, credentials or downloaded data.

## Checks

- [ ] This contains reusable entry points, not project-specific evidence.
- [ ] Jurisdiction scope and verification status are accurate.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_catalog.py` passes.
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes.
- [ ] The diff and PR body contain no personal information or credentials.

Maintainers handle approval and merging. Do not enable auto-merge.
